displayName: Project Self Review And Decay Prevention
taskGoal: Review maintained repository documents and demo contracts for signs of project decay, scope drift, stale governance, or implementation/documentation divergence.
workItemTitle: Demo project self review and decay prevention
agentGoal: Generate review findings and follow-up WorkItem suggestions without modifying documents or code.

toolContracts.description: Read selected maintained documents and local manifests to produce a self-review report.
Generate candidate follow-up WorkItems for drift, stale docs, missing tests, or weak governance boundaries.

failureSample.expectedBlockingPoint: Block before converting self-review findings into repository edits, issues, PRs, or member obligations.
failureSample.recovery: Ask the human owner to narrow the review surface, split by subsystem, and rerun without modifying repository files.

evaluationSamples.purpose: Verify that maintained docs and manifests can be checked for project decay without modifying repository files.
evaluationSamples.inputSummary: Selected maintained documents and local manifests are read as internal, redacted Demo Mode inputs.
evaluationSamples.purposeLimit: Demo Mode validation and human review only; not for training, ranking, production routing, or automatic assignment.
expectedGovernance: Do not automatically modify documents, code, issues, PRs, or configuration
Write candidate WorkItems only as review material
evaluationSamples.reportCardValue: Creates a governed project health review that can surface decay risks and candidate work without turning self-review into automatic repository changes.
